parameters.query: =SELECT day FROM kaspi_fx_rates WHERE day = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::date;

=INSERT INTO kaspi_fx_rates (day, cbr_date, kzt_rub, vnd_rub)
VALUES ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::date,
        '{{ String($json.Date).slice(0, 10) }}',
        {{ $json.Valute.KZT.Value / $json.Valute.KZT.Nominal }},
        {{ $json.Valute.VND ? $json.Valute.VND.Value / $json.Valute.VND.Nominal : 'NULL' }})
ON CONFLICT (day) DO UPDATE SET cbr_date = EXCLUDED.cbr_date, kzt_rub = EXCLUDED.kzt_rub,
       vnd_rub = EXCLUDED.vnd_rub, fetched_at = now()
RETURNING day;

=WITH input AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset('{{ $('Parse').first().json.sql_json }}'::jsonb) AS x(
    card text, op_date date, kind text, operation text, merchant text, merchant_norm text,
    amount_kzt numeric, orig_amount numeric, orig_currency text, occ smallint, dedup_key text)
), rate AS (
  -- самый свежий курс: сегодняшний, а если ЦБ не ответил — последний известный
  SELECT * FROM kaspi_fx_rates ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 1
)
INSERT INTO kaspi_expenses (card, op_date, kind, operation, merchant, merchant_norm, amount_kzt,
       orig_amount, orig_currency, amount_rub, rate_day, kzt_rub, occ, dedup_key)
SELECT NULLIF(i.card, ''), i.op_date, i.kind, i.operation, i.merchant, i.merchant_norm, i.amount_kzt,
       i.orig_amount, i.orig_currency, round(i.amount_kzt * r.kzt_rub, 2), r.day, r.kzt_rub,
       i.occ, i.dedup_key
  FROM input i
  LEFT JOIN rate r ON true
ON CONFLICT (dedup_key) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, card, op_date, kind, merchant, amount_kzt, orig_amount, orig_currency, amount_rub;
